verdict.rationale: Zulip documents channels, including public, web-public and private channels. It also documents one role-based membership rule: guests cannot self-subscribe to public channels. Admin-facing membership controls are not evidenced, so this falls short of full delivery. missing for 10: documentation of how admins create private channels and add or remove members, per-channel permission settings (e.g. who can post or invite), and independent or hands-on corroboration of membership management.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can organize conversations into public and private channels with membership controls

citations.quote: Everyone other than guests can subscribe to any public or web-public channel.
channels:public: Search messages in all public and web-public channels.
plus all the private channel messages and direct messages that members who have allowed administrators to export their private data can access.
you don't pay for SAML authentication, LDAP sync, or advanced roles and permissions.
